description:
In a world where implanted neural chips allow investigators to interrogate suspects through their own memories, detectives Kim Jin-Yeong and Seo Ji-Su prefer the old-fashioned method of chasing criminals on foot. Officially, they are colleagues-turned-lovers who divorced years ago; but off the record, they continue to seek each other out after work, haunted by a tangled relationship that neither has fully let go of. Then, one chilling Christmas night, Jin-Yeong disappears without a word. Exactly one year later on Christmas Eve, he returns and stands before Ji-Su as if nothing had happened. Where has he been, and what truth hides behind the silence of that missing year...?

(Source: Lezhin US)
